GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: App reported to Stewards that was fractious in the barriers and slow to begin. She further reported gelding had been assisted by a barrier attendant and requested that Stewards review the start to determine whether mount had been impeded. After reviewing footage Stewards were satisfied had not been impeded. Raced keenly in the early and middle stages. Near the 200m bumped.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Raced wide throughout. Near 900m raced keenly and had to be restrained from heels. When qstd, rdr advised following the incident her mnt overraced and as a consequence she allowed to shift out and obtain a trailing position behind rnr until passing 600m when that rnr shifted in to a two-wide line, resulting in her mnt continuing to race wide, but without cover from that point. Added raced flat on straightening, was disappointing and in her opinion, may have come to end of prep. Post-race vet exam rev no abs. Tnr advised pulled up well but would now be sent for a spell.
